inventory_source: git index membership under .venv-broken, compared with artifacts/storage_cleanup_phase2b_c4_manifest.json tracked_files_excluded
working_tree_identity: sha256 is the on-disk working-tree bytes, including the mixed line endings Git does not store

reconstruction.method: git checkout-index into a temporary work tree outside the repository; core.autocrlf was overridden only for that command

mixed_line_ending_exceptions.why_git_cannot_reconstruct: The Git blob is LF on every line. The working tree keeps LF on some lines and CRLF on others. core.autocrlf=true smudge converts every LF to CRLF, which is a third byte sequence. The clean filter removes every CR, so Git reports no modification, but the blob does not record which lines had CR.
